newsitem.title: USA: Scan-Optics sees Q4 EPS near $0.24-$0.30.
newsitem.headline: Scan-Optics sees Q4 EPS near $0.24-$0.30.

text.p: Scan-Optics Inc Friday estimated fourth quarter earnings would range from $1.6 million to $2.0 million, or $0.24 to $0.30 per share.
In the year-ago quarter, the company reported earnings of $100,000, or $0.02 per share.
The company also estimated revenues of about $14 million compared with $11.3 million for the previous year.
The firm said it estimates revenues of about $45.5 million for the 1996 year versus $42.1 million for the previous year.
It sees 1996 earnings ranging from $2.8 million to $3.2 million, or $0.41 to $0.47 per share, compared with a loss of $1.3 million, or $0.19 per share for 1995.
Final audited results for 1996 are expected to be reported in early February, it said.
